name: Zoomable Drag Gallery
description: Full-screen draggable image grid with inertia, zoom presets and fit control. Clicking an image flies it into a split-screen view with an animated numbered caption.
contents: Grid of images (rows x cols) on a draggable canvas
Zoom control bar with percentage and preset buttons
Split-screen detail view with number, title, description and close button
behavior: Preloader fades out, then images fly in from the center in a staggered grid reveal
Drag with inertia and edge resistance inside computed bounds
Zoom presets change scale and grid gap; keyboard 1, 2, 3 and F, Escape closes the detail view
Click an image to Flip it into the left half with high-res swap and line-split text reveal
Images outside the viewport fade to low opacity via IntersectionObserver
Controls bar and detail view adapt to small screens
editableByProps: Images, captions, grid size, tile size
Background, text and preloader colors (Tailwind classes)
Preloader duration and all UI labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the gap used at each zoom level

needsCodeEdit.where: CustomEase.create calls for gallery-smooth and gallery-center

fixed: Requires GSAP with Draggable, InertiaPlugin, CustomEase and Flip plugins
Root is h-screen with fixed-position layers; place it as a full-page section
Adds an overlay node to document.body during zoom and listens to document keydown, window resize and document mouseleave; all removed on unmount
Keyboard shortcuts 1, 2, 3, F and Escape are hardcoded
